messages:
Maya R: Heads-up Candidate (EU) for Staff SWE. Manager requesting comp-band exception + one-time sign-on. Need routing advice, cc @Owen T @Sara L
Owen T: What's the band delta and amount? Any relocation or visa?
Maya R: Band 4 -> band 5 (+15% base). Sign-on EUR 12,000. Candidate local, no visa. Manager wants start in 10 days (mid-pay-run).
Sara L: Finance: EUR 12k is high for sign-on. Recommend split: EUR 2k onboarding paid day 1, remainder at 60 days as relocation stipend. No gross-up.
Ben K: I can provisionally approve band uplift pending comp committee. Please include retention rationale and benchmark comps. Also confirm manager will sign change memo if approved.
Maya R: Will collect scorecard, manager note, and market comp data. Manager prefers earlier start; any payroll issues with mid-cycle?
payroll-bot: Payroll note: mid-cycle start OK; first pay prorated. Onboarding stipend <= EUR 2,000 triggers standard payroll. Anything >EUR 2,000 flagged for reporting; recommend split per finance.
Owen T: I'll open comp-exception ticket: include offer draft, candidate consent, finance note, and payroll recommendation. Legal review may not be required but will loop in if stipend language ambiguous.
Maya R: Thanks all. I'll update candidate with tentative structure: band uplift request + split sign-on schedule. Will post comp-exception link here when submitted. :thumbsup:
